mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.category_id,p.name,p.brand,p.gluten_type,p.usage_text,p.ingredients, p.storage,p.shelf_life_days,p.image_url,p.status,p.version FROM product_spu p JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.status='ON_SALE' AND c.enabled=1
SELECT id,category_id,name,brand,gluten_type,usage_text,ingredients,storage, shelf_life_days,image_url,status,version FROM product_spu WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE product_spu SET status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
